provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Tzolk'in rulebook (Czech Games Edition, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Wood, stone, gold, crystal skulls and unused workers in the bank; corn in the middle of the Tzolk'in gear
Jungle: {n} Corn Harvest Tiles on each group of fields; a Wood Harvest Tile on top of each in the groups for Palenque actions 3, 4 and 5
Turn the Tzolk'in gear so the arrowhead points at a blue-green end-of-age Food Day tooth
Shuffle Age 1 buildings, Age 2 buildings and monuments separately
Deal {n} monuments faceup; box the rest
Deal 6 Age 1 buildings faceup; both building stacks facedown by the board
Each player: a player board (lighter side up), 3 workers, 7 markers and a scoring counter on 0
Markers: 1 on the white step of each of the 3 temples, 1 on the leftmost space of each of the 4 technology tracks
Starting Player Marker to whoever most recently sacrificed something
Deal each player 4 Starting Wealth Tiles; keep 2, then all reveal and take what they show
The Starting Player Marker doesn't rotate - take it with a worker on the Starting Player Space
The starting player places or picks up workers, then clockwise
